description: This Java class 'DeviceSessionCtx' manages MQTT device session context within the Thingsboard platform, handling message queues, device profile updates, topic filtering, and payload adaptation.

classes.name: DeviceSessionCtx
classes.description: Manages MQTT device session state, including message queues, device profile updates, topic filtering, and payload handling within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: nextMsgId
methods.description: Generates the next message ID for MQTT messages.

methods.name: isDeviceTelemetryTopic
methods.description: Checks if a topic name matches the device telemetry topic filter.

methods.name: isDeviceAttributesTopic
methods.description: Checks if a topic name matches the device attributes publish topic filter.

methods.name: isDeviceSubscriptionAttributesTopic
methods.description: Checks if a topic name matches the device attributes subscribe topic filter.

methods.name: getPayloadAdaptor
methods.description: Returns the current MQTT transport adaptor used for payload processing.

methods.name: isJsonPayloadType
methods.description: Checks if the current payload type is JSON.

methods.name: setDeviceProfile
methods.description: Sets the device profile and updates session configuration accordingly.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to the device profile and reconfigures session parameters.

methods.name: updateDeviceSessionConfiguration
methods.description: Updates session settings based on the device profile's transport configuration.

methods.name: updateDynamicMessageDescriptors
methods.description: Updates protobuf message descriptors based on device profile configuration.

methods.name: getAdaptor
methods.description: Returns the appropriate MQTT transport adaptor based on topic type.

methods.name: getDefaultAdaptor
methods.description: Returns the default MQTT adaptor based on payload type.

methods.name: updateAdaptor
methods.description: Updates the current adaptor based on payload type and compatibility settings.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Adds an MQTT message to the session's message queue.

methods.name: tryProcessQueuedMsgs
methods.description: Attempts to process queued messages with a provided message processor.

methods.name: getMsgQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the message queue.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases unprocessed messages and logs a warning if messages remain.

methods.name: getMsgQueueSnapshot
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable snapshot of the message queue.
